LESSON: READING 5.2.1 READING FOR INFORMATION – PLAYS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information – Plays

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information – Plays. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you read for information?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vocabulary related to cultural heritage for language acquisition
2. respond to a text on the theme for comprehension

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 5.2.1 READING FOR INFORMATION – PLAYS
This lesson teaches Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information – Plays for Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify vocabulary related to cultural heritage for language acquisition
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. respond to a text on the theme for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information – Plays using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information – Plays above.
2. Explain Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information – Plays to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information – Plays.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information – Plays with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information – Plays important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you read for information?
2. How can plays be used to preserve our cultural heritage?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify vocabulary related to cultural heritage for language acquisition
2. respond to a text on the theme for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
